bias.zh: 反弹 · 站上 5 日和 10 日均线，仍低于 $62.6–64

read.en: Intel fell 2.1% on Nov 12 to $61.20, trading $59.41–62.76 on light volume (0.53x the 20-day). It is above the rising 5-day ($59.50) and the 10-day ($59.43) and below the 30-day ($85.85), 100-day ($98.88) and rising 200-day ($87.34). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($76.95), and RSI is 33.4.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月12日下跌 2.1%，收于 $61.20，盘中区间 $59.41–62.76，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.53 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$59.50）和 10 日均线（$59.43）上方，30 日（$85.85）、100 日（$98.88）和上行的 200 日均线（$87.34）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$76.95），RSI 为 33.4。

read.en: The dip to $59.41 held the 10-day, now below price; the $62.76 high stalled at the $62.5–62.6 cap again. Resistance is $62.5–62.8 (Nov 11 close, Nov 3 and Nov 12 highs), then $64.1 (Nov 11 high) and $65.7 (Nov 2 high). Support is $59.4–60.7 (5 and 10-day, Nov 9–10 highs), then $58.1–58.4 and $56.8. A close above $62.8 would target $64–65.7; below $59.4, $58.

r.en: Nov 11 close $62.50; Nov 3 high $62.59; Nov 12 high $62.76
